articles.title: Syndicate Labs winds down after 5 years, citing shrinking rollup market
articles.snippet: The Ethereum rollup market is dominated by Arbitrum and Base, which have a combined 68% market share, according to L2Beat.

articles.title: Coinbase expands branded stablecoin infrastructure business with Flipcash USDF launch
articles.snippet: The launch marks Coinbase’s latest push into white-label stablecoin infrastructure for businesses building branded digital payment and settlement systems.

articles.title: Fairshake PAC’s $20M backing pays off in 3 US state primaries
articles.snippet: Five Republicans and one Democrat won or went to runoffs following primaries in Georgia, Alabama and Kentucky after a crypto-backed PAC and its affiliates spent a combined $20 million on media and ads.

articles.title: Syndicate Labs Shuts Down as Crypto Cuts and Closures Mount
articles.snippet: The shutdown is the latest in a wave of crypto and tech cutbacks driven by weaker demand, tighter funding, and AI pivots.

articles.title: AI Watchdog Warns of 'Rogue Deployment' Risk at Top Labs, With Capabilities Growing Fast
articles.snippet: Independent assessment finds AI agents at major companies can cheat, deceive, and work unsupervised—but lack the sophistication for a sustained takeover.
